notes.title: A New Location!
notes.content:
Just a small update today, keeping things fresh.

v1.1.1 Changes & Additions:
[list]
[*]Added a new environment for a total of two: inside a volcano and on a desert island.
[*]Hidden player 3 & 4 when only 2 or 3 players are playing.
[*]Fixed a bug that didn't allow the countdown to begin properly.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added a new environment for a total of two: inside a volcano and on a desert island.
Hidden player 3 & 4 when only 2 or 3 players are playing.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that didn't allow the countdown to begin properly.

notes.title: Vegetables!
notes.content:
v1.1.0 Changes & Additions:
[list]
[*]Added vegetables that increase the size of the player.
[*]Players return to normal size after losing all their stamina.
[*]Decreased the height of the fist at the end of the punching animations.
[*]Game Over text now displays the colour of the winner.
[*]Game Over text now transitions by spinning onto the screen.
[*]Added a countdown at the beginning of each round that also spins in and out.
[*]Added sound effects to the countdown.
[/list]
